name: forearm-wall-slide
instructions:
1. Setup in a standing position with a staggered stance with your forearms on a wall at roughly shoulder height.
2. Exhale and slide your palms up the wall until the elbows are completely locked out.
3. Lift your hands off the wall and maintain a neutral spinal position.
4. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
